text: MBCA Section 7.32 requires a writing but, departing from earlier statutes, does not require the agreement to sit in the articles or bylaws, so stand alone written shareholder agreements are expressly valid.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3017612

isBasedOn.name: Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America

abstract: The agreement must be in writing, but unlike some earlier statutes, the written agreement does not have to be in the articles or bylaws—stand-alone written agreements are specifically allowed.
